title: Bano (sa) Ki Fughan
body:
Bano(sa)ki fughaan thi mere Dilbar Ali Asghar(as),
Marne se tere ghar me hai mehshar Ali Asghar(as).
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ghurbat ko teri dekh ke maidan e wigha me,
Rone laga baatil ka bhi lashkar Ali Asghar(as).
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Jab halq chhida teer e jafa kaar se tera,
Rone lage sar peet ke Sarwar(as)Ali Asghar(as).
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Qaimey ki taraf badhte hain ruk jate hain Sarwar(as),
Nanhi si teri laash utha kar Ali Asghar(as).
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Tha teer e sitam se hi gala pehle Jo zaqmi,
Phir us pa chala zulm ka khanjar Ali Asghar(as).
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Khoon rota raha dil ye mera sonch ke har dum,
Kyu qatl hua tera mukarrar Ali Asghar(as).
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Sooni hui godi meri ankho mai dhuwaan hai,
Jab se tu gaya janib e Kausar Ali Asghar(as).
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Har saahib e ehsaas ko raaho me rulaya,
Tha nok e sina par jo tera sar Ali Asghar(as).
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Peshani-e-Islam pe tehreer hai ab tak,
Qurbaan hue Deen e Khuda par Ali Asghar(as).
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Saahil ki tamanna hai ye Hasnain ki khwahish,
Nouha ye rahe sabke laboun par Ali Asghar (as)
